001package dayplanner;
002
003
004/**
005 * <p>
006 * Represents an activity categorized as taking place at home, such as a chore
007 * or a study session. It inherits the common title, times, optional comment,
008 * serialization, and comparison behavior from {@link Activity}.
009 * </p>
010 * <p>
011 * Example:
012 * </p>
013 * 
014 * <pre>
015 * new HomeActivity("Laundry", start, end, "Wash bedding")
016 * </pre>
017 */
018public class HomeActivity extends Activity {
019    /**
020     * Constructors
021     */
022
023    /**
024     * Constructs a <code>HomeActivity</code> with a title, start time, and end
025     * time.
026     * 
027     * @param title     The activity title.
028     * @param startTime The start time.
029     * @param endTime   The end time.
030     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If title is null or blank, if startTime or
031     *                                  endTime is null, or if startTime is not
032     *                                  strictly before endTime.
033     */
034    public HomeActivity(String title, Time startTime, Time endTime)
035    throws IllegalArgumentException {
036        super(title, startTime, endTime);
037    }
038
039    /**
040     * Constructs a <code>HomeActivity</code> with a title, start time, end time,
041     * and comment.
042     * 
043     * @param title     The activity title.
044     * @param startTime The start time.
045     * @param endTime   The end time.
046     * @param comment   Optional note associated with the activity; null or blank
047     *                  values are treated as no comment by {@link Activity}.
048     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If title is null or blank, if startTime or
049     *                                  endTime is null, or if startTime is not
050     *                                  strictly before endTime.
051     */
052    public HomeActivity(String title, Time startTime, Time endTime, String comment)
053    throws IllegalArgumentException {
054        super(title, startTime, endTime, comment);
055    }
056
057    /**
058     * Constructs a <code>HomeActivity</code> from a RAS (Readable Activity Serial)
059     * string.
060     * 
061     * @param ras Serialized activity entry, normally produced by {@link #toRAS()}.
062     * @throws RasException when RAS input is invalid.
063     */
064    public HomeActivity(String ras)
065    throws RasException {
066        super(ras);
067    }
068
069    /**
070     * <p>
071     * Copy constructor. Constructs a new <code>HomeActivity</code> that is a
072     * duplicate of the given <code>HomeActivity</code>, preventing co-references
073     * that could cause privacy leaks.
074     * </p>
075     *
076     * @param other The <code>HomeActivity</code> to copy.
077     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code other} is {@code null}.
078     */
079    public HomeActivity(HomeActivity other)
080    throws IllegalArgumentException {
081        super(other);
082    }
083
084
085
086    /*
087     * Activity Overrides
088     */
089
090    
091    
092    /**
093     * Returns the {@link dayplanner.ActivityType} that corresponds to this Activity.
094     * @return Corresponding ActivityType. For HomeActivities, this is <code>HOME</code>.
095     */
096    @Override
097    public ActivityType getType() {
098        return ActivityType.HOME;
099    }
100
101    
102
103    /*
104     * Object Overrides
105     */
106    
107    /**
108     * Determines whether this home activity is equal to another object.
109     * 
110     * @param other The object to compare with.
111     * @return <code>true</code> if the objects are equal, <code>false</code>
112     *         otherwise.
113     */
114    @Override
115    public boolean equals(Object other) {
116        if (this == other)
117            return true;
118        if (other == null || getClass() != other.getClass())
119            return false;
120        return super.equals(other);
121    }
122}
